Description: Hello City of Berkeley, We're so happy to be here. After a decade in San Francisco's SOMA neighborhood and the weirdness of 2020-2021, we decided to move our business to two buildings in Oakland and Berkeley. The Berkeley community has been wonderful to be a part of.  We took over the facility/brand known as The Rare Barrel and are continuing to operate their brand as well as ours in the 940 Parker Space. We have not made any changes to their pre-existing layout. Same facility, different operators. We updated our ABC license to show the proper ownership. I am available by email or cell for any questions and am happy to assist in any way through this process. Thank you so much and happy holidays. Best, Connor
